findings.scenario: Parent sets externalSessionError (expired/foreign session). User then selects files via Add files, or an upload succeeds. handleFiles only clears local error/sessionExpired and never calls onExternalSessionErrorClear except from resetAndReselect. The alert stays up, still appends “Choose the files again…”, and that button wipes the just-staged uploads and session.
findings.remediation: Call onExternalSessionErrorClear at the start of a new selection and on a successful POST; show the expiry recovery CTA only when this attempt actually failed as expiry (401/sessionExpired) or the parent error is still the active failure.

findings.scenario: A DNS-rebinding page (Host/Origin both attacker.com, browser treats the request as same-origin so sec-fetch-site is same-origin) reaches the local process. Origin equals new URL(request.url).origin because the URL is built from the spoofed Host. Authorization passes before any body quota, so a hostile site can still spend staging quota—the attack the route comment claims to block—without ONE_BOX_API_TOKEN.
findings.remediation: Allowlist Host/URL to loopback names (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]) and require a non-cors Sec-Fetch-Site or the configured bearer for mutations; do not treat Origin==request.url.origin as sufficient.

findings.scenario: A 401 with a non-JSON body (proxy/HTML) makes json() throw. The catch path never clears uploadSession/uploads or sets sessionExpired, so bearer-expiry recovery does not run and the user sees a parse error.
findings.remediation: Branch on response.status before parsing; on 401 always clear session+selection and set sessionExpired, then optionally parse a message.

findings.line: file input disabled (137) vs Add files (117)
findings.scenario: Add files is disabled at MAX_UPLOAD_FILES but the visually-hidden input is not, and it stays in the tab order. Keyboard/AT users can still open the picker and hit a client-only count error.
findings.remediation: Disable the input with the same predicate as the button and set aria-hidden/tabIndex={-1} on the hidden control.

audit.proof_assessment: No proof artifacts were supplied. Review is from the git slice only; stageUploads/inspectUpload/inspectZip behavior is not visible.
residual_risks: Type, magic-byte, and ZIP safety are not enforced in the route; they are assumed inside stageUploads. Client accept/size checks are advisory.
Per-request file cap is 5; session-total quota and staged-byte deletion on Remove are not in this slice.
readBoundedBody has no read timeout; a slow body can hold the handler until the platform kills it.
Without ONE_BOX_API_TOKEN, any local client can spoof Origin and POST.
